Сара Мисирска.“ — „Преп.“ is the rank, which `types` already carries, and „Мисирска“ is a **toponymic by-name and not a see**, Egypt being a country and no rank word in the heading governing it, so §6 keeps it and the form is the fullest this calendar gives. **It is also the only by-name any of her three calendars prints**, doxologia and saint.gr both giving a bare rank and forename. `foldchk.py` returns no holder and `sr-foldpred.mjs` predicts a new key with no other holder.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 13 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the Greek line is as bare as the Romanian one — «Οσία Σάρρα» against «Sfânta Cuvioasă Sara» — with the same rank and the same absence of a byname. The corpus keeps no other Sara, and the amma of the Paradise of the Fathers that the Greek page quotes is the venerable woman the day keeps. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence, and the page prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 26.07.2026 (13. јул ст. ст.) — „Преп. Сара Мисирска.“

attestations.note: The day’s fourth entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, with its closing full stop, which is what §4 asks for and what `srbody.mjs` now hands back. **THE IDENTIFICATION IS THE DAY AND THE BARE RANK, BECAUSE THAT IS ALL ANY OF THE THREE BOOKS GIVES.** doxologia prints «Sfânta Cuvioasă Sara» and saint.gr «Οσία Σάρρα», both of them a rank and a forename and nothing else, both on this very 13 July; and this heading adds the one word none of them has, „Мисирска“, Egyptian. One woman, one rank, one day in three calendars. **`dates` WRITTEN WHERE THE FOLDER HAD NONE.** `dates: null` before — neither other book gave a year. This book ends „Упокојила се у Господу 370. год.“, so `death` is 370 to 370, display «370», basis traditional: a flat year into an empty field, which the narrowing rule permits. **The sixty years she spent on the bank of the Nile are a duration** and nothing is reckoned back from 370 by them, though 310 would be the answer. `types` UNTOUCHED at `venerable`, which „Преп.“ is and all the heading gives. **`virgin` is refused**, „Као девица отишла на подвиг“, as a virgin she went out to the ascetic life, standing in the body — and this is the second `virgin` refused off a body in this wave. **`ascetic` is refused on the same ground**, „подвизавала се“ being a verb in the body and „Преп.“ the only rank in the heading. **`abbess` is refused twice over**: she drew many women to the monastic life „Својим примером“, by her example, which is not an office, and the book gives her no community to be head of. No `office`, no `locations` — the Nile and Alexandria are a narrative. **§10, AND A DISPLAY NAME THIS BOOK COULD IMPROVE.** The `display_name` is «Sara (13 July)», which disambiguates her by the day because the two books the folder was built from gave nothing else to do it with. **This book gives „Мисирска“**, Egyptian, and the body gives the Nile and Alexandria — so the day in the display name is no longer the only thing available. §10 reserves a display name to the author: it is left exactly as it stands and reported. The slug keeps the day for the same reason a slug always may; a slug is not a name. No new `related` rows: the many women she drew to the monastic life are unnamed, and `nicodemus-the-hagiorite`, whom the folder already relates, is not named in this book. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

death.note: The folder held no dates at all; doxologia printed «Sfânta Cuvioasă Sara» and saint.gr «Οσία Σάρρα», a rank and a forename each with no year. The Охридски пролог for 13. јул ст. ст. ends „Упокојила се у Господу 370. год.“ The sixty years it says she spent on the bank of the Nile are a duration and nothing is reckoned from them.
